notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-11. Source sup-used-newegg-tesla-m40. The Tesla M40 24GB (Maxwell GM200, 24GB GDDR5) is the absolute cheapest 24GB accelerator on the secondary market ($189.00, or ~$7.88 per GB of VRAM). Severe architectural gotchas: Maxwell (compute capability 5.2) lacks both tensor cores and INT8 DP4A instructions; inference is limited to FP32 or emulated formats in llama.cpp, delivering slow decode tokens/sec; passive cooling requires blower mods; EPS-12V 8-pin power wiring differs from standard PCIe 8-pin; driver support capped on modern CUDA toolchains.
